text: Alder & Finch reported serving 640 active customers in its 2025 annual review. The document does not state a 2022 revenue figure. Customer count is not a revenue measure.

text: Alder & Finch stores EU customer records in Rotterdam, Netherlands. Backups are encrypted and retained for 30 days. The residency statement applies to production customer records, not employee email.
